items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: So, we got a fellow with a guitar. So, we go upstairs to his room and we started jamming right there between them with

ctx.x: You mentioned Roy Eldridge a little earlier. How did you relate to Roy's style?

I liked Roy. I was in school when I first met Roy. I was touring with the school band through Cincinnati, and Roy was playing with one of the bands there in Cincinnati. I'm trying to think of the name. I can't recall it now. The Cotton Pickers? McKinney Cotton Pickers? I'm not sure that's the band. But, I met him in Cincinnati. And then, when he finished his job and I finished ours, we was in a club at a hotel. So, Roy and I met there and started talking. And we, I don't know how we finally knew each other, but…
this guitar. And, that's how we happened to kind of know each other from then on through the years.
